value.value: Rapid regime: P(SiMe3)3, p-Cl and p-CF3 phosphines; p-Cl and p-CF3 are reported at about 90% conversion by 30 min. Slow regime: P(SiPh3)3 and p-Me phosphine reach similar conversion after about 60 min. Approximate 90-min LEET values are ~530 nm for fast and ~585 nm for slow sources.
